description: This line plot compares the performance of different query selection strategies for DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) during inference, measured by MRR@10 on the MS-Marco dev set. The x-axis represents the number of queries used during inference, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S)”, and ranges from 2 to 10 on a linear scale. The y-axis represents the MRR@10 score, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5 on a linear scale. The plot displays six lines, each corresponding to a different DPR training strategy: “DPR w/o query” (black solid line), “DPR w/ gold” (yellow solid line), “DPR w/ top-1” (green solid line), “DPR w/ bottom-1” (purple solid line), “DPR w/ random” (blue solid line), and “DPR w/ curriculum” (red solid line). For each strategy, a dotted line of the same color represents the performance when using the typical representation (without corpus expansion), while the solid line represents performance with corpus expansion. The “DPR w/o query” strategy starts at 34.0 and remains constant. The “DPR w/ gold” strategy starts at 33.0 and increases to 35.0. The “DPR w/ top-1” strategy starts at 34.5 and increases to 36.5. The “DPR w/ bottom-1” strategy starts at 35.0 and decreases slightly to 34.5. The “DPR w/ random” strategy starts at 35.0 and remains relatively flat. The “DPR w/ curriculum” strategy starts at 35.2 and remains relatively flat.
